name: The Tempest's Weapons

faq.answer: Bath'rah is a troll hermit and craftsman living in the Alterac Mountains who works with elemental forces.

aliases: eye of the tempest turn in
where to bring eye of the tempest
faq.answer: The Eye of the Tempest must be brought to Bath'rah the Windwatcher in the Alterac Mountains.
faq.q: Where do I deliver the Eye of the Tempest?

aliases: what does eye of the tempest do
faq.answer: The Eye of the Tempest is a powerful elemental artifact won through battle against the elements.
faq.q: What is the Eye of the Tempest?

sections.body: A fierce clash against the elements leaves you holding the Eye of the Tempest. The storm has settled, and Bath'rah the Windwatcher awaits you among the heights of the Alterac Mountains. The hermit knows the ways of such forces and watches for what you bring.
sections.title: A Relic for the Windwatcher

sections.body: Bath'rah recognizes the Eye as an artifact of deep and ancient strength. It has been a long time since the Windwatcher worked such power into shape. He bids you guard what cost so much to claim.
sections.title: Craft of the Storm

summary: You hold the Eye of the Tempest, drawn from a trial against the primal elements. Now you bring the potent relic into the Alterac Mountains to find Bath'rah the Windwatcher.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Tempest's Weapons
